required.why: a cleared opt-out (reset) must mean out, not in: the default is true
lifecycle events are not in the catalog (the default is true)
a second global error handler beside the error net and crash reporting
the region is chosen on purpose; the default host is https://us.i.posthog.com
reset() otherwise reloads feature flags: a /flags request carrying the anonymous and device ids on every withdrawal (preloadFeatureFlags: false does not stop it)
the React Native reset() keeps the device id unless it is told to keep nothing, so the stable id would survive a no and forget()
reset() keeps the event queue and a flush ignores the opt-out, so events captured just before a no would still be sent

requiredWhenAnonymous.why: anonymous analytics: identify() becomes a no-op

banned.why: session replay records what the user typed and saw
touch autocapture sends element text and accessibility labels (user content)
automatic screen capture sends route names with their params
the provider constructs the client at render, before consent, and autocaptures

autoStartSdks.expo-insights: sends an event on every cold start, automatically (Expo docs, EAS Insights > App usage, read 2026-10-14): it cannot wait for consent

expo-observe.why: dispatches startup metrics, logs and the installation's EAS client id from every release build by default (dispatchingEnabled defaults to true; Expo SDK 57 docs, Observe API and EAS Observe > Configure, read 2026-10-14)
expo-observe.fix: Configure it with dispatchingEnabled: false at module scope and turn dispatching on only after the user agreed (crash-reporting-and-observability owns that consent decision), or uninstall it.

bannedKinds.session-replay: records the screen: what the user typed and saw is collected
bannedKinds.native-capture: PostHog's native plugin adds session replay, native crash capture and rage clicks: data outside the event catalog (crashes belong to the crash reporter)

localOnlySdks.expo-app-metrics: collects startup, frame-rate, memory and session metrics on the device; expo-observe dispatches them (expo-app-metrics 57.0.22 read in its package on 2026-10-14: no uploader, its network code only monitors the app's requests)
